chunks: And in the narration of ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mughīrah, he said:
"There is no harm in a man counting his salat (prayer) with his ring or with pebbles that he takes in his hand and counts with them."

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to count salat (prayer) using a ring or pebbles?
ai.summary: This hadith states the permissibility of using a ring or pebbles to keep count during salat (prayer). It indicates a legal allowance in managing the units or elements of prayer without invalidating the act.
